caption: Save a two-letter chord and its text.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['pocket-letter-chords']; p.flushInput(); p.settings={paused:false,dictionaries:[{name:'Default',folder:'',bindings:[{keys:'qw',text:'Done'},{keys:'as',text:'Action item'},{keys:'xz',text:'Next review'}]},{name:'Project review',folder:'Pocket Letter Chords/Projects',bindings:[{keys:'qw',text:'Ready for review'}]}]}; await p.saveSettings();p.pro.signOut();app.commands.executeCommandById('pocket-letter-chords:edit-dictionary'); return 'ok';})()

caption: The q and w chord inserts Done in the meeting note.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['pocket-letter-chords']; p.flushInput(); p.settings={paused:false,dictionaries:[{name:'Default',folder:'',bindings:[{keys:'qw',text:'Done'},{keys:'as',text:'Action item'},{keys:'xz',text:'Next review'}]},{name:'Project review',folder:'Pocket Letter Chords/Projects',bindings:[{keys:'qw',text:'Ready for review'}]}]}; await p.saveSettings();p.pro.signOut(); const v=app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; await v.setState({mode:'source',source:true},{history:false}); v.editor.setCursor(v.editor.lastLine(),0); electron.remote.getCurrentWindow().focus(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); v.editor.focus(); if(!v.editor.hasFocus()) throw new Error('Editor has no focus'); const target=document.activeElement; for(const k of ['q','w']) target.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:k,bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); for(const k of ['q','w']) target.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{key:k,bubbles:true})); if(!v.editor.getValue().endsWith('Done')) throw new Error('Chord did not insert'); return 'ok';})()
